trials.claim: Lifetime deal exclusively at Earlybird (one-time payment lifetime access)
trials.claimQuote: Get your Quicklead Lifetime Deal exclusively at Earlybird
trials.reasoning: The terms describe regular non-refundable, auto-renewing subscriptions, but do not show that Earlybird lifetime buyers are charged or moved to those subscriptions. No exhibit directly confirms or denies the lifetime deal itself.

exhibits.quote: All purchases are non-refundable. You can cancel your subscription at any time by logging
exhibits.argument: Terms state purchases are non-refundable subscriptions, not one-time lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Your subscription will continue and automatically renew unless canceled. You consent to our
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes service as auto-renewing subscription, contradicting a one-time lifetime payment.

trials.claim: Isolated client workspaces are not capped on any tier
trials.claimQuote: workspaces are not capped on any tier of this deal, so the number of clients you can run is limited by your account count and nothing else.
trials.reasoning: The exhibits describe separate workspaces for clients but give no tier list, cap, or limit on workspace numbers. They neither confirm workspaces are uncapped on every tier nor show they are capped.

exhibits.quote: Ten profiles split across separate workspaces so client data never mixes.
exhibits.argument: Workspaces are tied to the 10-account Agency minimum, not available uncapped on every tier.

exhibits.quote: Separate data, templates, analytics and LinkedIn accounts per client, with no cross-contamination
exhibits.argument: Isolated workspaces are listed as a tier-gated feature, contradicting claim they are uncapped on any tier.

trials.claim: Configurable safety limits: connection requests 20 to 80 per day and messages 50 to 150
trials.claimQuote: connection requests adjustable from 20 to 80 a day and messages from 50 to 150.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states LinkedIn messages are up to 100 a day per account, which directly conflicts with the claimed configurable range up to 150 messages a day.

exhibits.quote: LinkedIn allows roughly 100 connection requests a week, about 20 a day, with some variation
exhibits.argument: Vendor cites LinkedIn limit of ~20 per day, contradicting configurable 20-80 per day claim.

exhibits.quote: LinkedIn messages Up to 100 a day per account, within your own safety caps
exhibits.argument: Vendor caps messages at 100 per day, contradicting claim of up to 150 per day.

trials.claimQuote: Try it out for 30 days to make sure it’s right for you!
trials.reasoning: The binding terms state all purchases are non-refundable, which directly conflicts with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

exhibits.quote: All purchases are non-refundable. You can cancel your subscription at any time by logging
exhibits.argument: Terms explicitly deny refunds, contradicting a 30-day money-back guarantee.

exhibits.quote: Yes, 7 days, full product access, no credit card required. Import real leads, launch a real campaign
exhibits.argument: Vendor offers only a 7-day free trial, not a 30-day trial or guarantee period.

trials.claim: Runs entirely in the cloud so campaigns keep working with laptop shut and nothing installed
trials.claimQuote: runs entirely in the cloud, so campaigns keep working with your laptop shut and nothing gets installed on your machine.
trials.reasoning: The vendor states Quicklead is 100% cloud-based, runs 24/7 even when your machine is off, and campaigns keep sending while you are offline. The generic uptime and service-change disclaimers do not contradict that cloud operation.

exhibits.quote: We cannot guarantee the Services will be available at all times. We may experience hardware, software, or other problems
exhibits.argument: Vendor disclaims guaranteed uptime, undermining claim campaigns keep working uninterrupted with laptop shut.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to change, revise, update, suspend, discontinue, or otherwise modify the Services at any time
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to suspend or discontinue service at any time, contradicting always-on cloud execution.

exhibits.quote: No. Quicklead is 100% cloud-based. Once your campaigns are live they run on our servers 24/7, even when your machine is off, asleep, or you are on holiday.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms product runs 100% in cloud and continues while machine is off, supporting laptop-shut operation.

exhibits.quote: Campaigns keep sending and replies keep arriving while you are offline
exhibits.argument: Vendor states campaigns continue sending while user is offline, supporting cloud execution claim.

trials.claim: Message Open Profile members for free without using InMail credit
trials.claimQuote: and message Open Profile members for free without using a single InMail credit.
trials.reasoning: The vendor directly states Open Profile messages are free with no InMail credit and no connection request needed. That only about 20% of Premium members enable Open Profile does not contradict a claim limited to Open Profile members.

exhibits.quote: Roughly one in five LinkedIn Premium members has Open Profile switched on, which means anyone can message them
exhibits.argument: Free messaging only applies to ~20% of Premium members with Open Profile enabled, not all members.

exhibits.quote: Roughly 18-25% of Premium members have it enabled. Quicklead auto-detects those profiles and sends free InMails
exhibits.argument: Vendor limits free InMail to a small subset of Premium members, contradicting unlimited free messaging claim.

exhibits.quote: Message Open Profiles for free: no connection request, no InMail credit.
exhibits.argument: Vendor directly states Open Profile messages are free without InMail credit or connection request.

exhibits.quote: Free Open Profile InMails No InMail credits, no Premium seat for the sender, no connection request needed
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms free Open Profile InMails require no InMail credits and no connection request.
